text:
Lina R.: Follow-up from Atlas outage postmortem. Short recap: customer on-prem BGP churn + our isolation controller misclassified transient route withdrawals as tenant split -> broad isolation event; impact ~4h on dedicated pool. We need concrete owners, timelines, and a recurrence detection plan.

Lina R.: Proposed action list:
• Stabilize peering (BGP timers, route-policy, keepalives) — owner/ETA
• Isolation controller patch (debounce + origin-AS verification) — owner/ETA
• Canary + automation for on-prem peering validation — owner/ETA
• Runbook + smoke-test steps pre/post peering change — owner/ETA
• Alerting rule + automatic incident ticketing for flaps — owner/ETA

Omar V.: I can own peering stabilization. Plan: tighten hold-time, add per-peer flap dampening, enforce neighbor ACLs for Atlas-only prefixes. ETA: plan + staging test in 10 days, rollout in 18 days.

Priya S.: Ill take the isolation controller patch. Quick design: 1) 30s debounce window for route withdraws, 2) require matching origin-AS and prefix length checks, 3) add metrics for false-positive isolations. ETA: hotfix in 4 business days, canary in 9 days.

Jasper (sre): Ill build the canary harness and smoke tests. Suggest we use a synthetic /24 and a canary tenant in staging before touching prod. ETA: 6 days for harness + 2-run validation.

Nora C.: Ill update runbook and coordinate Atlas maintenance window. Will set a 2-hour validation window post-change and request customer telemetry (BGP logs). ETA: runbook update in 3 days, customer window by EOD tomorrow.

rdw-bot: Jira tickets created: RDW-2401 (atlas-peering-stabilize), RDW-2402 (isolation-controller-debounce), RDW-2403 (onprem-canary-harness). Links: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2401 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2402 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2403

Omar V.: Preflight check (staging):
```
# quick bgp neighbor state on rtr01
ssh ops@rtr01 'vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"'
```

Priya S.: Local sim for route churn (test router):
```
# simulate withdraws
for i in 1 2 3; do ip route add 203.0.113.0/24 via 198.51.100.$i; sleep 20; ip route del 203.0.113.0/24; done
```

Jasper (sre): Alert proposal: create alert if >2 BGP resets for a peer within 15m OR >5 route changes for atlas-prefixes in 10m -> auto-open RDW incident + tag atlas. Add Grafana tile: "peer_flaps_30d".

Lina R.: Prioritization: mark RDW-2402 (controller hotfix) as prio:critical, RDW-2401 prio:high, RDW-2403 prio:medium. Hotfix blocks canary rollout.

rdw-bot: Calendar invite created: "Atlas peering remediation sync" at 2235014400. Invitees: @Omar V., @Priya S., @Jasper (sre), @Nora C., @Lina R.

Omar V.: small note: can we avoid touching hold-time too low on backbone; prefer dampening + targeted keepalive increase per-customer neighbor.

Priya S.: agreed. debounce + sanity checks first, then policy changes after canary.

Lina R.: OK confirm owners & ETAs here by EOD. If any blocker, call it out.

Omar V.: confirmed owner RDW-2401, ETA plan+staging 10 days.

Priya S.: confirmed owner RDW-2402, ETA hotfix 4 business days.

Jasper (sre): confirmed owner RDW-2403, ETA harness 6 days.

Nora C.: confirmed runbook + customer coord in 3 days.

Lina R.: Thanks all. Ill add these lines to the postmortem action list and schedule a check-in on the calendar invite. If anything changes, update the Jira ticket and ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
